Seen • Just now
Yes — damaged items are handled differently from a normal return.
Normal return:
• Must be requested within 7 days of delivery.
• A 10% restocking fee usually applies.
• The item must be in as‑new condition and may require repackaging.
Damaged or defective item:
• No restocking or return fees are charged.
• Return or exchange shipping is covered.
• The damaged item may be picked up and replaced during the same visit, and repackaging is not required.
If the damage is reported within 7 days, photos may be reviewed to determine the next step.
So in short: damaged items avoid the usual return fees and are treated as a defect rather than a standard return.
